name: Braflix
description: Direct play for movies and TV episodes from Braflix's own players: an HLS stream up to 1080p (its default server) and MP4 files, found by the title's TMDB id and played through the server.

listing.summary: Stream movies and TV episodes from Braflix's players: HLS up to 1080p and MP4 files, no torrent.
listing.description: Braflix (braflix.at) lists about thirty third-party embed players for a title. This plugin reads the two that are Braflix's own and answer plain JSON: its default server (vidsrc.party: an HLS stream, most titles in 1080p / 720p / 480p with English audio and subtitles) and "Vidsrc HD" (braflix.dev: MP4 files, usually 480p and 360p, sometimes 1080p). Both show in a title's Play, in the Stream group, for movies and for episodes. Each is a switch in the settings. The other embed players encrypt their streams or sit behind Cloudflare challenges and are left out.
listing.disclaimer: Streaming copyrighted content may be illegal where you live. Educational project.

settings.label: Braflix (HLS)
settings.description: Braflix's default server (vidsrc.party): an HLS stream, most titles up to 1080p, English audio and subtitles in the stream.

settings.label: Vidsrc HD (MP4)
